study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping cerebellar anatomical heterogeneity in mental and neurological illnesses

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study combined data from 132 scanning sites including ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, UK Biobank, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, PNC, and TOP. This represents a large multi-site dataset for normative modeling of cerebellar anatomy.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The cohort of individuals without diagnoses was obtained from 132 scanning sites, including various studies such as ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, and UK Biobank." ... "As for the clinical datasets, we combined data from ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Kim2023.pdf.md: Methods / Population data, L139-141; Methods / Clinical data, L145-147

answer.ABIDE (I+II): Normative model training/testing (healthy controls) and clinical sample (ASD patients)

answer.ADNI: Normative model training/testing (healthy controls) and clinical sample (AD, MCI patients)

answer.AIBL: Normative model training/testing (healthy controls) and clinical sample (AD patients)

answer.TOP: Normative model training/testing (healthy controls) and clinical sample (BD, SZ patients)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls from all datasets were split into training (27,117) and testing (26,985) sets for building normative models of cerebellar anatomy. Clinical samples from ABIDE (ASD: n=900), ADNI (AD: n=146, MCI: n=122), AIBL (AD), DEMGEN (dementia), and TOP (BD: n=277, SZ: n=312) were used exclusively in the testing phase to evaluate individual-level deviations from normative patterns.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We split our sample of individuals without diagnosis into training and test sets on the basis of on scanning site, sex, and age." ... "However, only the test set consisted of diagnostic groups (for example, AD, ASD, BD) with a minimum of 100 participants."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was constructed for cerebellar morphology (both lobular volumes and voxel-wise gray matter probability values). The total healthy control population was 54,102 individuals, split into training (27,117) and testing (26,985) sets. The model was trained on 27,117 healthy controls and tested on 26,985 healthy controls plus 1,757 clinical participants.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The total number of participants in the individuals-without-diagnosis population was 54,102 (53% female), and the clinical set was 1,757, encompassing <56,000 in total." ... Table 1 shows: "Training set: 27,117" and "Testing set: 26,985"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Training set: mean age 54.36 years (SD 20.31). Testing set: mean age 54.52 years (SD 20.19). The overall weighted mean was calculated as: (27117*54.36 + 26985*54.52)/(27117+26985) = 54.44 years. Pooled SD was calculated as: sqrt(((27116*20.31^2 + 26984*20.19^2)/(27117+26985-2))) = 20.25 years. Age range spans from 3 to 85 years across the full sample.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Both training and testing sets have a 53:47 female-to-male ratio. For the overall phase (N=54,102): Female N = 54102 * 0.53 = 28,674; Male N = 54102 * 0.47 = 25,428. For the training phase (N=27,117): Female N = 27117 * 0.53 = 14,372; Male N = 27117 * 0.47 = 12,745. These values are calculated from the reported percentages.
